none: PAS LON-1E4A38: Roman copper alloy coin: barbarous radiate of Tetricus I
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin: barbarous radiate probably of Tetricus I dating AD271-4. Reverse: possibly PAX AVG. Obverse: Radiate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [---] VS AVG. Reverse: Draped figure standing right holding upright sceptre in left hand and right hand held up. Reverse inscription: Illegible possibly [PAX AVG]. Mint mark: C/-//---. Die axis measurement: 8.00. Dimensions: diameter: 15.89mm; weight: 1.21g
